guidelines.detail: same as LRN-005 (The description supports the reported transitions, while the missing-flow records show that several connections in the progression were omitted. This is essentially the sequence-flow guidance already captured by LRN-005.)

documentation rule FID-02 not applied (The description explicitly says that onboarding and contract execution occur before the process ends, while M1 records that the execution activity has no counterpart in the generated model. FID-02 already advises preserving separately described actions and their dependencies, so this guideline is already covered.)

refines FID-01 (The description identifies participant-performed work at the start. The reference models it as an activity before the next activity, while the generated model uses a start event for that work, so this is a choice of BPMN element rather than a missing element. The guideline refines the general instruction to model every distinct described activity.)

documentation rule FID-02 not applied (The description names supplier onboarding and contract execution as completion outcomes, while the generated model has no counterpart for the contract-execution activity. The proposed guideline is already covered by FID-02, which says to preserve separately described actions and their dependencies.)

same as LRN-016 (The description states that the company identifies the need, and the records show that the reference models this as a task while the generated model uses a start event for the same action. LRN-016 already gives essentially the same guidance.)

refines FID-03 (The description distinguishes proposal evaluation, optional supplier visits or interviews, and the beginning of negotiations from criteria, alternatives, and later outcomes. The matched labels show these details being folded into task labels. This refines the documented guidance on short, faithful labels by clarifying what to do when an activity has associated details.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description presents distinct activities in an ordered progression, including transitions into, through, or out of branches or synchronization points: Connect each consecutive activity with a sequence flow, preserving the stated transitions through branches and synchronization points.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states a progression of process steps from initiation through activities to a completion outcome

rules_sent_back.instruction: Do not merge separately described actions into one task or split one stated action without a process reason. Preserve described dependencies.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that process completion depends on more than one distinct action

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies work performed by a participant as the first step of the process: Model that work as an activity after a start event and before the subsequent activity; do not represent the work itself as the start event.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies work performed by a participant as the first step of the process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity together with criteria, optional supporting actions, or a later outcome associated with it: Label the BPMN task with a concise verb-object phrase for the activity itself. Keep associated criteria, alternatives, and subsequent outcomes out of the label unless they define the activity.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity together with criteria, optional supporting actions, or a later outcome associated with it
